name: Grilled Balsamic Steak with Pepper Relish & Creamy Cucumber Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat steak dry with paper towels. Add to the bowl with the marinade and turn to coat. Set aside to marinate, 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
1 red bell pepper
½ lemon
1 English cucumber
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Place in another medium bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim, seed, and quarter bell pepper lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the jalapeño along with oil, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add peppers and grill until charred, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate to cool slightly. (Reserve pan for later use and bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, juice lemon into the reserved bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp avocado oil mayonnaise
½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp dill, dried
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing, stir to combine, and set aside.
When the steak is done marinating, return the pan to medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Small dice cooled peppers. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine the pepper relish.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp balsamic vinegar
½ tsp oregano, dried
⅛ tsp salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide cucumber salad and steak between plates or bowls. Top steak with pepper relish and enjoy!
